objective:
Build the EXTRACTION interpreter (prompt version 4) and its corpus recorders for the subject+action tagging redesign. Background: today one AI call matches a capture to one activity from a shortlist (prompt v3, GeminiNanoActivityInterpreter). The redesign asks the AI ONLY to extract, in the user's own words: operation, SUBJECT (what it was done to: 'hot tub', 'lawn mower'), ACTION (what was done: 'change filter', 'get gas'), state, time wording and DURATION wording. The AI is NOT shown any existing activity/tag list. Deterministic logic (TG1.3, not this task) later resolves those words against existing tags. This task delivers the extractor, its tests, a recording format for extraction answers over the tag corpus (core-testing tag-corpus.json, built in TG1.1), a device recorder and a stand-in recorder. No resolver, no scoring, no app wiring.

DECISIONS ALREADY MADE (follow them):
(1) BESIDE, NOT INSTEAD. The v3 interpreter stays exactly as it is: the app keeps using it until Stage 3. Do NOT change InterpretationPrompt.kt, InterpretationResponse.kt, InterpretationResponseDecoder.kt, PROMPT_VERSION, INTERPRETATION_SCHEMA_VERSION, the v3 drift-test pins, corpus.json, or the existing recordings/baseline. All existing tests must still pass unchanged (you may only make additive/refactoring edits to test helpers listed in write_paths, see (6)).
(2) core-domain gets plain types only, in a new package com.mcfrenchpants.activityledger.core.domain.extraction (one file, e.g. ExtractionTypes.kt, KDoc on everything, style like interpretation/InterpretationTypes.kt):
   - ExtractionInput(rawText: String, capturedAt: Instant, zoneId: ZoneId)  -- note: no candidates.
   - ExtractionCandidate(operation: InterpretationOperation, subject: String?, action: String?, activityState: ActivityState?, temporalExpression: String?, durationExpression: String?) -- UNTRUSTED model output (KDoc must say so; validation/resolution is TG1.3's job).
   - sealed interface ExtractionResult { Success(candidate: ExtractionCandidate); Failure(kind: InterpreterFailureKind) } -- reuse the existing InterpreterFailureKind and InterpreterProvenance.
   - interface ActivityExtractor { val provenance: InterpreterProvenance; suspend fun extract(input: ExtractionInput): ExtractionResult } with the same never-throws/cancellation contract as ActivityInterpreter.
   No logic, no tests needed beyond compiling; do not touch any other core-domain file.
(3) core-ai, all new files in package com.mcfrenchpants.activityledger.core.ai:
   - ExtractionPrompt.kt: internal const EXTRACTION_PROMPT_VERSION = "4"; internal const EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION (terse, numbered, like v3's); internal fun buildExtractionPrompt(input: ExtractionInput): String -- pure, deterministic, locale-independent, no logging, same '## Current context' block and '<<<UTTERANCE ... UTTERANCE>>>' fencing as v3. Content rules the prompt must convey: subject = the thing acted on, as a short noun phrase in the user's words, without articles/possessives/filler ('the hot tub' -> 'hot tub'; 'changed the filter in the hot tub' -> subject 'hot tub', action 'change filter'; keep the full name: 'lawn mower' is not 'lawn'); action = short verb phrase, verb in its plain form, keeping the object words that distinguish it ('change oil' vs 'change filter'; 'mowing' -> 'mow'); leave subject empty when the sentence names none ('Just finished mowing.'); copy time wording verbatim, never compute a date; a duration ('for half an hour', '40 minutes') goes in duration wording and is NEVER time wording; state COMPLETED/IN_PROGRESS only when said; tolerate obvious speech-recognition slips without inventing content; questions about the past are QUERY_HISTORY. Worked examples MUST NOT reuse any rawText from tag-corpus.json or corpus.json, and should use subjects/actions that do not appear in the tag corpus (e.g. water heater / flush, smoke detector / replace batteries, bikes / pump tires) so the measurement is not trained on the test.
   - ExtractionResponse.kt: @Generable data class ExtractionResponse with nullable String fields, in this order: operation (@Guide enumValues LOG_ACTIVITY, QUERY_HISTORY, UNSUPPORTED), subject, action, activityState (enumValues COMPLETED, IN_PROGRESS), temporalExpression, durationExpression. No confidence field (the model's self-reported confidence is no longer used for decisions, and every extra field costs device latency). Same KDoc/ADR-023 notes as InterpretationResponse, @param:Guide target, @Guide texts written for the model.
   - ExtractionResponseDecoder.kt: shape-only, pure, total decoder mirroring InterpretationResponseDecoder (required operation; optional state that fails if unrecognised; free text trimmed, blank -> null; case-insensitive enum match; own closed failure-code enum). No semantic validation.
   - GeminiNanoActivityExtractor.kt: class GeminiNanoActivityExtractor(capability: OnDeviceModelCapability) : ActivityExtractor, plus suspend fun warmUp(). Provenance: interpreterVersion EXTRACTOR_VERSION = "gemini-nano-extract-1", promptVersion EXTRACTION_PROMPT_VERSION, schemaVersion EXTRACTION_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1. Same generation settings constants as the v3 interpreter (temperature/topK/candidateCount/seed/maxOutputTokens/thinking/includeSchemaInPrompt -- reference the existing constants, do not copy values), same readiness check (never downloads), one call, no retry, same failure mapping (UNAVAILABLE / RETRYABLE for BUSY or positive retry delay / MALFORMED / OTHER), cancellation rethrown, nothing logged. You MAY move the private GenAiException.isWorthRetrying helper into a small shared internal file so both classes use it, provided GeminiNanoActivityInterpreter's behaviour and its tests are unchanged.
   - consumer-rules.pro already keeps every @Generable class generically; confirm that and do not edit it unless it would not cover ExtractionResponse.
(4) core-ai tests (src/test/.../core/ai/): ExtractionPromptTest (no candidate/catalog section; utterance fenced verbatim; context rendering; deterministic for equal input; duration-vs-time and subject/action rules present; no tag-corpus or corpus.json rawText appears in the prompt or system instruction -- load both via core-testing's TagCorpus/SemanticCorpus and assert), ExtractionPromptDriftTest (pins EXTRACTION_PROMPT_VERSION == "4" and SHA-256 of the system instruction and of the prompt for one fixed input, same message style as InterpretationPromptDriftTest), ExtractionResponseDecoderTest, ExtractionResponseSchemaTest (field names/order/enum values via annotations, like InterpretationResponseSchemaTest), GeminiNanoActivityExtractorTest (readiness gate & no download, exactly one generateContent call, generation settings asserted against the constants, every failure mapping, cancellation, decode failure -> MALFORMED, provenance). For the fake session: generalise FakeInterpretationSession (or add a sibling fake) so it can return ExtractionResponse too, without changing what existing tests observe.
(5) core-testing (package ...core.testing.corpus, main source set):
   - TagRecording.kt: recording format for extraction answers over the tag corpus, modelled on SemanticRecording.kt (same strict Json config, header comment documenting the shape, FORMAT_VERSION = 1, read/write incl. OutputStream, ISO recordedAt check, duplicate caseId check). Header fields: formatVersion, source (reuse RecordingSource), modelLabel, deviceModel, interpreterVersion, promptVersion, schemaVersion, tagCorpusSha256 (TagCorpus.sha256), recordedAt, notes, entries. Entry: caseId, answer: RecordedExtraction? XOR failureKind, latencyMs (>= 0 or null). RecordedExtraction = the six ExtractionCandidate fields with toCandidate()/of(). TagRecordingEntry.of(caseId, result: ExtractionResult, latencyMs) is the only mapping recorders use. No field for raw model text.
   - TagCorpusExtractionInput.kt: object TagCorpusExtractionInput { fun forCase(case: TagCorpusCase): ExtractionInput } -- the ONE place deciding what the extractor is shown for a tag case (rawText, capture instant, zone; nothing from the catalog fixture). Use TagCorpusCase's existing accessors.
   - Tests (src/test/.../corpus/): TagRecordingTest (round trip, explicit nulls, unknown key rejected, wrong formatVersion rejected, answer/failure XOR, negative latency, duplicate ids, bad recordedAt); TagCorpusExtractionInputTest (every case maps rawText/instant/zone exactly); TagRecordingFilesTest: for each of recordings/tag-device-latest.json and recordings/tag-standin-latest.json that EXISTS (Assume-skip when absent), it decodes, its tagCorpusSha256 equals TagCorpus.load().sha256, its source matches the file (DEVICE / STAND_IN), and it has exactly one entry per tag-corpus case id. This is a structural check only -- no scoring (TG1.4).
(6) Stand-in recorder (core-ai test source set, opt-in, host-only): generalise StandInSchema so it can derive the schema from either InterpretationResponse or ExtractionResponse (keep its existing public behaviour for InterpretationResponse identical; StandInSchemaTest must still pass, add coverage for the extraction schema). Add extraction support to the Ollama client (either a sibling class or an extract(ExtractionInput): ExtractionResult method on OllamaStandInClient) that sends EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION + buildExtractionPrompt(+schema rendering when INCLUDE_SCHEMA_IN_PROMPT) with the same generation options and loopback-only rules, and decodes through ExtractionResponseDecoder with the same OTHER/MALFORMED mapping; add unit tests mirroring OllamaStandInClientTest's request-body/decoding coverage (no network). Add StandInTagCorpusRecorderTest mirroring StandInCorpusRecorderTest: opt-in via system property tagStandIn=true, output from tagStandIn.output, reuses semanticStandIn.model / semanticStandIn.baseUrl overrides, iterates TagCorpus.load().cases via TagCorpusExtractionInput, writes a STAND_IN TagRecording atomically, one console summary line of counts/timings/path only, refuses to overwrite when every call failed at transport level. In core-ai/build.gradle.kts add the matching opt-in block: -PtagStandIn=true sets systemProperty tagStandIn=true and tagStandIn.output = core-testing/src/test/resources/semantic-corpus/recordings/tag-standin-latest.json (plus the model/baseUrl passthrough), never up-to-date/cached, show standard streams. Do not change the existing semanticStandIn block's behaviour.
(7) Device recorder: app-phone/src/androidTest/kotlin/com/mcfrenchpants/activityledger/semantic/TagCorpusRecorderTest.kt, mirroring SemanticCorpusRecorderTest exactly in safety behaviour (opt-in instrumentation argument tagCorpus=true else Assume-skip; readiness READY else skip, never download; MainActivity RESUMED around the whole loop; warmUp once untimed; fast-refusal BUSY backoff identical; numbers-and-path-only logging; atomic write) but using GeminiNanoActivityExtractor, TagCorpus, TagCorpusExtractionInput and TagRecording, writing <externalFilesDir>/semantic-corpus/tag-device-recording.json. Do not modify SemanticCorpusRecorderTest; small duplication is acceptable. It must compile (:app-phone:compileDebugAndroidTestKotlin); it cannot be run in this task (no AI phone).
(8) Scripts: add an optional first argument --tags to scripts/semantic/run-device-corpus.sh and scripts/semantic/run-standin-corpus.sh. Without it, behaviour is byte-for-byte what it is today. With --tags: the device script runs TagCorpusRecorderTest with tagCorpus=true, pulls .../files/semantic-corpus/tag-device-recording.json, does the same pre-overwrite check, writes recordings/tag-device-latest.json, then runs ONLY TagRecordingFilesTest (there is no tag gate or report yet) and says so; the stand-in script runs *StandInTagCorpusRecorderTest with -PtagStandIn=true, writes recordings/tag-standin-latest.json, then runs TagRecordingFilesTest. Update the scripts' header comments and the 'This will' text (tag corpus is 72 sentences). Run `bash -n` on both scripts.
(9) Docs: docs/SEMANTIC_CORPUS.md section 12 -- replace the closing 'no recorder...' paragraph with a concise description of the extractor (prompt v4, beside v3), the TagRecording format, the two recorders and `--tags` script usage, and that replay/scoring/gate is still TG1.4. Update core-testing/src/test/resources/semantic-corpus/recordings/README.md with the two new tag files. Add ADR-038 to docs/DECISIONS.md (same format as ADR-037): 'Interpretation becomes extraction-only (prompt v4), built beside v3' -- context (9 of 15 real watch entries mis-filed at HIGH confidence; matching against a near-empty list over-matches), decision (model extracts subject/action/time/duration/state with no list shown; deterministic resolution later; separate EXTRACTION_* version constants; v3 stays live until Stage 3 swaps the app over; confidence dropped from the schema), consequences.

RULES: no capture text, prompt text or model output in any log, println, exception message or test failure message (ids, counts, field names and reason codes only -- AGENTS.md #11). ML Kit types stay inside core-ai and never appear in a hand-written public signature (ADR-023). No network except the opt-in loopback stand-in. Do not run the stand-in or device recorders (no Ollama server is running and no AI phone is attached); do not create tag-device-latest.json or tag-standin-latest.json. Do not touch BACKLOG.md, PROGRESS.md, docs/proposals, .sdlc, corpus.json, tag-corpus.json, existing recordings or baseline.
non_goals: No tag normalizer, resolver, decision policy or InterpretationValidator change (TG1.3).
No replay, scoring, report, baseline or gate for the tag corpus (TG1.4).
No change to the v3 interpreter, its prompt, schema, version constants, drift pins, or the app's capture pipeline (Stage 3).
No running of the device or stand-in recorders, and no recording files created.
No edits to corpus.json, tag-corpus.json, existing recordings or baseline.json.
acceptance_criteria: core-domain has ExtractionInput, ExtractionCandidate (documented as untrusted), ExtractionResult and ActivityExtractor in a new extraction package; no other core-domain file changed.

core-ai has GeminiNanoActivityExtractor with provenance (gemini-nano-extract-1, prompt '4', schema 1), the v3 generation settings by reference, readiness gate with no download, one call, the v3 failure mapping, rethrown cancellation and no logging; ML Kit types do not appear in any hand-written public signature.

The extraction prompt and system instruction show no candidate/tag list, fence the utterance, separate duration from time, state the subject/action rules, and contain no tag-corpus or corpus.json sentence (asserted by a test); EXTRACTION_PROMPT_VERSION is '4' and its text is pinned by a drift test.
ExtractionResponse has exactly operation, subject, action, activityState, temporalExpression, durationExpression (no confidence); its decoder is shape-only and total, with tests.

The v3 interpreter path is unchanged: PROMPT_VERSION still '3', InterpretationPrompt/Response/Decoder and InterpretationPromptDriftTest untouched, and every pre-existing test in core-ai, core-domain, core-testing and app-phone still passes.

core-testing has TagRecording (strict, versioned, no raw-text field), TagCorpusExtractionInput as the single input builder, and TagRecordingTest / TagCorpusExtractionInputTest / TagRecordingFilesTest passing (the files test skips when no tag recordings exist).

A stand-in tag recorder (opt-in -PtagStandIn=true, loopback-only) and a device tag recorder (opt-in tagCorpus=true, never downloads, foreground held, BUSY backoff, numbers-only logs, atomic write) exist; the device recorder compiles; neither was run and no tag recording file was created.
run-device-corpus.sh and run-standin-corpus.sh accept --tags as described, behave exactly as before without it, and pass bash -n.

docs/SEMANTIC_CORPUS.md section 12, the recordings README and a new ADR-038 in docs/DECISIONS.md describe the extractor, recording format and recorders; no capture text, prompt or model output is logged anywhere.
